paragraphs.source_en: Sōtatsu liked to render bracken in silver leaf, but with the passing years, silver darkened and turned gray. Unless every detail was carefully considered, the portions written in kana would become difficult to decipher in years to come. For the calligraphy, it would be best to ask Kōetsu to lend her some models to study. Kōetsu was a master calligrapher, acclaimed by the great lords of the realm and their retainers, whereas A-Sachi’s writing could only call to mind the shriveled, rigid vine of a withered morning glory. There was no need to hurry; first she must practice her hand diligently.
